**Review every file an agent just changed—without leaving DeepSeek Harness Web.**
💬 Chat  →  ✨ Generate  →  📄 Click a changed file  →  🔍 Review
1. This plugin supports standard, PTC, and Creator modes, but **does not currently support Minimal m

ode**.
2. Review every file the agent just changed, shown in the `Diff` panel.
3. Enable DSH's `appl
y_patch` tool by default when installed. Review text file creation, editing, deletion, and moves, wi

th undo and reapply support.
> Use `apply_patch` to review file deletions and moves; the plugin capt

ures the original content and file permissions before deletion.
4. Add comments to changed lines and
ask the agent to continue making updates based on the feedback, or ask questions about the changes.
5. Automatically wrap long text while reviewing. Enable it under Settings → Plugins → Plugin config

uration → File review; it is disabled by default.
6. Multilingual support — both English and Chinese

review; it is disabled by default.
6. Multilingual support — both English and Chinese are supported.
The badge above shows the DSH CLI version this release was tested against. This release supports `0.
2.2-rc.1` through the `0.2.2` release and requires Node.js 24.9 or later. The exact DSH range is `en
gines.dsh` in package.json, with the same range declared in `peerDependencies`.
Outside that range, DSH refuses to load the plugin. To run it anyway at your own risk, grant an exem
